data.simulator: INDELible v1.03 (GTR+G, indel rate 0.02, root length L=500)
data.nrf_convention: standard root-independent (unrooted) RF via nrf_standard.py: non-trivial splits canonicalised to the side lacking the lexicographically smallest leaf; RF=|S1-S2|+|S2-S1|; nRF=RF/(2(n-3)), n=200 -> /394
data.previous_convention: calc_nrf_simple.py kept only the smaller child clade per internal node (~64/197 splits captured) and is therefore biased low and rooting-dependent
data.nj_implementation: BioPython DistanceTreeConstructor().nj (fusang_v4_dahp_v1.build_nj) for every distance-matrix method; fusang_spaced_k5 additionally uses the official CLI (fusang_v2.py --tree_method nj --kmer_k 5 --kmer_gap gap2), which applies a BME/NNI refinement pass that competitor methods do not receive

fusang_spaced_k5_nj.label: Fusang spaced k=5 gap2 (plain NJ, no NNI)

fusang_spaced_k5.label: Fusang spaced k=5 gap2 (CLI: NJ + BME NNI)
